Unrecognised is the one stage A outcome that requires a question, and in a no-human run it collapses to None by default. That makes None absorb two different things — prompts that genuinely have no game type, and prompts whose game type was one question away — and the record cannot distinguish them.

notes_for_us: A ten-word prompt produced a claimable-house town with enterable interiors and a P3 route. The genre's own notes warn that the housing model is the single highest-cost decision here and to check which model the game is before assuming one, and the preset makes exactly that assumption on the user's behalf. The rule and the preset are in direct conflict on short prompts.

Roleplay & Avatar Sim splits pet games across two presets — Pet Care in a town, Animal Sim in wilderness with dens — and the deciding fact is whether the player is the animal. A prompt saying pet game and big town names one half of each, and step 1 has to commit before step 5 can ask.

Pets themselves have no home in the handoff. They are not npc-population, which is who inhabits the space, and they are not spawners. The subject of the game ends up recorded only as a mechanics line.
